notes.title: Talk to Yuno
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30957784/4c65d6e3b413a7e21b5be708f21f0b0bf71ad1b8.png[/img]

We are excited to announce that the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/search/?franchise=Talk%20to...]Talk to...[/url]  line will soon be joined by a new member, [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/956620/Talk_to_Yuno/]Yuno[/url]!

Yuno has been interested in the occult since a young age.
However, most of her attempts so far failed to produce any results.
Spells had little effect, predictions were hit and miss....

Armed with a new crystal ball and a book about summoning, Yuno decided to double her efforts.

After patiently waiting for the planets to align, drawing an elaborate magic circle and chanting the right incantation...
She finally managed to summon...... [b]YOU![/b]

See [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/956620/Talk_to_Yuno/]Talk to Yuno[/url] for more details!

P.S. You can ask Aya about Yuno. They've known each other since middle school. Just ask "Who is Yuno?" or use "Yuno" as a keyword.

notes.title: Updates and More
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30957784/7a6b433718ce016b6d4425c422bb28d342d5ed59.png[/img]
[h1] Updates[/h1]
[list]
    [*]The greeting system was expanded
    [*]New keywords
    [*]New questions  (don't forget the question mark when asking questions!)
    [*]Small text corrections
    [*]Other fixes for minor bugs.
[/list]
[h1]Saki[/h1]
We are excited to announce that the [b]"Talk to..."[/b] family will soon be joined by a new member, Saki!
Saki is an energetic girl who loves spending time outdoors.
See [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/771100/Talk_to_Saki/]Talk to Saki[/url]  for more details!

Aya and Saki are good friends.
They have known each other since middle school.
Aya might mention her from time to time.
Or you could just mention Saki's name and see what Aya has to say!

(Note: You can now check the current version by typing "version". It should be 1.02)
